howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose DPI
howto.text: Higher DPI gives sharper output. 150 DPI for screen, 300 for print, 600 for archival.

howto.name: Download a ZIP of BMPs
howto.text: Each page becomes one BMP file. BMP is uncompressed so files are LARGE — typically 5-30 MB per page at 300 DPI.

faq.q: Why are BMPs so much larger than PNG?
faq.a: BMP stores every pixel uncompressed. PNG losslessly compresses to ~20% the size. Use BMP only when you specifically need uncompressed pixel data.
Legacy Windows software that doesn't support modern formats; embedded systems; precise pixel manipulation.

faq.q: Can I get just one page as BMP?
faq.a: Extract that page first with Extract Pages, then convert.
